title: Love the functionality, but some design flaws
text:
Love the functionality, but some design flaws. This works really well for cleaning areas that are difficult to reach with a corded model (hallways and stairs in particular are difficult in my home). The carpet cleaning brush actually feels like it self-propels the unit forward which is cool, and the LED lights were particularly useful in spotting broken glass after a drinking cup had fallen and shattered. Works well on hardwood and carpet flooring (and unlike another review I read here, it doesn't leave any marks on our hardwood flooring- I'm not sure what that's about).
So why only 3 stars? For starters, the battery life doesn't seem that great. My home isn't that large, a modest 1,500 square feet, but the battery seems to struggle making it through an entire house cleaning in one shot. Twice we had to stop and charge it before we could finish. We have accepted that perhaps it is better to clean parts at a time rather than the entire house at once, but I'd have hoped this would last longer or at least come with a spare battery to swap and keep going.
Secondly, the collection cup is very easy to accidentally pop out and empty when you didn't want it to. That reference above to picking up glass that shattered? My son was using it to vacuum our stairs the same day and accidentally knocked the cup loose releasing all the debris all over the stair case, including some shards of glass that were still inside. If they made that part more secure and the battery life longer, I would gladly give this 5 stars. For now, I'd give it a three.

MULTI-SURFACE CLEAN UP - Angled floorhead and 3-speed control built to vacuum hard surfaces, area rugs, and carpets
HAND-HELD CAPABILITY - Easily converts to a hand vacuum for cleaning stairs, furniture, and other hard-to-reach areas
ONE-TOUCH DUSTBIN - Removable, front-facing .65 liter dustbin comes off in seconds
TWIST TO CLEAN - Built-in filter cleaner provides up to twice the suction
description: The BLACK+ DECKER BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX* POWERSERIES™ Extreme™ Cordless Stick Vacuum is made to take on messes big and small. The 3X Cleaning System gives you 3-speed control for cleaning dust, crumbs, hair and more from hard floors, area rugs, and carpet. The patented anti-tangle brush bar can be activated to minimize hair wrap and maximize suction power. Easily access and empty the .65 liter front-facing dustbin with one touch. Then, convert the whole unit to a hand vacuum in just seconds for cleaning stairs, furniture, and other hard-to-reach places. Clean for up to 55 minutes** powered by a removable BLACK+DECKER 20V Max* Lithium Ion Powerconnect Battery that works with your other power tools in the cordless BLACK+DECKER 20V Max* Lithium Ion Powerconnect family. The unit’s built-in filter cleaner provides up to twice the suction thanks to twist-to-clean technology.
